scope: Waltz of the Ebon Manor rewards: Victory drops one Ebon Hatbox per frozen member; the hatbox opens to one of five weapons (Moonshear, Moonloom Harp, Ebon Thimble, Ballroom Chandelier, Severing Silk); all five craft The Last Waltz companion. Shared half-resolution Ebon pixel layer, reward pixel art and 27 cues. No packet, protocol or Raid timing change
target_build: 0.3.61 / protocol76 (0.3.60 during the pre-merge playtests; re-bumped after #96 took 0.3.60)

owner_direction.request: 2026-10-02: design a Doll-style treasure box and one weapon per class for the Ebon Manor, dopamine-heavy; build them with the care the owner liked in Soboro; brief Codex first, then proceed with what does not need art
owner_direction.concept: each weapon turns one of Noirette's techniques into the player's (shears, loom strings, thrown furniture, chandeliers, severing web); the companion brings the parasol waltz and Noirette herself; builds climb a B-minor pluck arpeggio and releases land on a chord

checks.first_owner_play: 2026-10-02 04:49-04:51 Host & Play on the installed 0.3.60 (5cbbb672) with a temporary probe build: every reward projectile reached its draw hooks at the right screen position and the pixel layer rendered and composited every frame (cut-line chalk, threads, strings and the large crescents were visible in the owner's capture), but every final pixel-art sprite (shear halves, needle, furniture, piano, spool, scissors, chandeliers, hatbox parts, waltz poses) was invisible. Cause: EbonRewardArt cached the first Value of an AsyncLoad request, which is the empty loading placeholder. Fixed by loading those small textures synchronously on first use; the probe was removed
